[ אָשְׁיָה ] noun feminine wall, bulwark (Talmud אָשִׁיתָא (Levy Nö); Mandean אשיתא wall Nö M 113 ; ᵑ7 plural suffix אֲשִׁיתָהָא (Dalm WB אָשְׁיָתַהָא ) Jer 50:15 , אשיתנא Cant 2:9; Arabic column, support is loan-word according to Frä 11 ); — only plural suffix bulwarks of city of Babylon,' etc.
